expectations.name: 01-acts-on-the-reason
expectations.text:
The agent acts on why reminders go by SMS: it tells the 2025 email trial and its missed pickups, then leaves the change
out, asks before switching or switches while warning that it brings them back.
expectations.evidence: The agent's last message only states 'The docs retain the previous trial's finding: missed pickups rose from 6% to 13% with email' and reports the switch as already done ('Switched pickup reminders to email... and updated the docs'). It never mentions the full 2025 trial (April–June dates, a third of emails never opened, fresh food thrown away, reversion to 6% on July 1), never asked before switching, and does not explicitly warn the user that switching now brings the missed-pickup risk back — it just restates the old stat as a fact already handled in the docs.

expectations.name: 02-names-a-fact
expectations.text: The agent's last message carries the trial's measured result, 13% missed pickups or 34% unopened emails.
